requirements: Treat missing principal entries as empty permission sets.
Return one change object per principal whose effective permissions differ.
Each change object has { principal, add, remove }.
add contains desired permissions absent from current permissions.
remove contains current permissions absent from desired permissions.
Deduplicate and lexicographically sort permission names.
Sort change objects lexicographically by principal.
Omit principals with no additions or removals.
Do not mutate the input objects.
